content: PRF availability must be feature-detected at create() time by checking clientExtensionResults.prf.enabled in the registration response (only present as an output of create(), not get()). If enabled, actual PRF *values* are only returned during a subsequent get()/authenticate() ceremony (clientExtensionResults.prf.results.first/.second as ArrayBuffers) - PRF is never usable directly from the create() response. If the authenticator/browser combo doesn't support PRF at all, the prf key is simply absent from clientExtensionResults on get(), not an error - callers must treat absence as the honest-fallback signal, not throw.
